memory_bridge: Use the crossed ten-tally at a feast: ten servings make the guests say 十分 for On ジュウ, while counting all ten pieces one by one ends with 十 for Kun とお.

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 十分（じゅうぶん）is common, modern, and pedagogically useful.
readings.overlay: Pile food around the crossed tally until everyone says 十分（じゅうぶん）, “enough”; its first character supplies On ジュウ.

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 十（とお）is common, modern, and pedagogically useful.
readings.overlay: Count the ten tally pieces to the end and name the total 十（とお）; the standalone native count fixes Kun とお, “ten.”

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 上面 is a common modern anchor for this distinct reading.
readings.overlay: The upper mark sits above the baseline in 上面; tap down from the top onto it, and let shàng fall with the finger.
